_comment: Upstream release tracking for the versions pinned in projects.cmake.
host     'github', or 'gitlab' with an explicit 'api' base URL
prefix   stripped from the upstream tag to give the projects.cmake version
string, so it must preserve that project's own separator style
pattern  the resulting version must match this in full; filters out junk
track    how large a jump may be proposed automatically:
patch  only the last component may increase
minor  anything within the current major (the default)
Projects deliberately not tracked here are listed in 'untracked' below.
check_updates.py warns about anything in projects.cmake missing from both,
so a newly added dependency can't silently go unwatched.

untracked.pcre: 8.45 is the final PCRE1 release and it lives on SourceForge, which has no release API. Moving to PCRE2 is a manual port.
untracked.hdf5: Upstream abandoned the hdf5-1_10_10 tag scheme; releases are now plain 2.x with a different tarball layout, so a bump needs the URL reworked by hand. USE_HDF5 is OFF by default.
untracked.libmsym: Pinned to a commit rather than a release, and WIN32 uses a different commit from everything else.
